dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Eh, books are just a non-starter. With Akasha's shutdown, the Akademiya is sure to revise the way they manage books.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Not like I ever like those things anyway, so nope, those waters are not for me. I'll just stick to the basics.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Besides, making Mora is easy. Even with half my talent, you should still be able to make as much as the Homayanis.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Heh, if the Akademiya could have made an argument to get me to enroll that was half as convincing as my sales pitches back then, I wouldn't have turned them down on the spot.
